description: This file declares functions and macros related to speed-density calculations used in engine control firmware. It includes conversions between units, function declarations for calculating charge temperature, air mass, and fuel, and initialization routines.

methods.name: getTCharge
methods.description: Calculates the charge temperature based on RPM, throttle position, coolant, and air temperature.

methods.name: getCylinderAirMass
methods.description: Computes the mass of air in the cylinder based on volumetric efficiency, manifold absolute pressure, and temperature.

methods.name: sdMath
methods.description: Performs speed-density related math calculations involving air mass and mixture ratio (AFR).

methods.name: setDefaultVETable
methods.description: Initializes or resets the volumetric efficiency table.

methods.name: getSpeedDensityFuel
methods.description: Calculates the fuel amount based on speed-density parameters.
